definitions: A common surname of English origin.
A town in Tirol, Austria, known for its historic old town and mint.
A village in New South Wales, Australia, near Canberra.
A former administrative county in Sweden, now part of Halland County.
examples: Mr. Hall will be attending the meeting.
Hall in Tirol is a beautiful place to visit.
The Hall family reunion is next month.
She visited Hall, Australia, last year.
